$comment: The pin manifest. A build is in this repository iff a TRACKED file of Archipelago-CC names it; scripts/procgen/check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs in that repo gates the FOUR-way agreement between this manifest, the .gitignore whitelist, what git actually tracks here, and the build names that repo’s tracked files actually spell. Every build directory carries exactly four files. `js`/`wasm` are the AUTHORITY on the payload filenames — they do not always match the directory name. `capabilities` is the BUILD-SIDE HALF OF FEATURE DETECTION (⚖ user, 2026-08-29): the host decides from DATA whether a feature applies, never from an opt-in flag, so a build DECLARES what its ActionScript can do and the panel looks the entry up by the directory name its preset points at. It is MANDATORY and an empty array is a real answer — absence would be indistinguishable from “measured, none”. The vocabulary is declared ONCE, in the consumer (Archipelago-CC frontend/modules/flashPanel/seedlingRandomizerEligibility.js WASM_BUILD_CAPABILITIES), and check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs imports it rather than spelling a second copy, so a typo cannot pass as “this build does not have it”. ⚖⚖ THE MANIFEST-PROSE EXEMPTION (ruled by the user 2026-08-30, EDITOR INTEGRATION slice P4): a gitlink bump whose submodule diff touches ONLY this file AND whose per-build payload md5s are byte-identical owes the pins gate plus the bounded reach, NOT the full-tier drive — the md5 identity is QUOTED in the outer commit as the licence. It is written where the OWED gate reads (Archipelago-CC scripts/procgen/check-seedling-full-tier-owed.mjs, which is what prices the tier) and restated here because this is the file the edit claiming it is made in. ⛔ THE BOUNDARY IS THE PREMISE, and it is all three clauses: touch a build directory, an md5 field or the .gitignore whitelist in the same commit and the exemption does not apply — a payload that moved is a different game, which is exactly what only the full tier can see. ⛓ `summary`, `role` and `source` (SEEDLING ORIGINAL WASM slice W2, ⚖ user 2026-09-07) ARE THE README'S BUILD TABLE, and the table is GENERATED from them — Archipelago-CC scripts/procgen/seedling-wasm-readme.mjs --write writes the `GENERATED:seedling-wasm-builds` region of README.md, and check-seedling-wasm-pins.mjs row (i) imports the same --check. `role` is one of demo / default / candidate / control, the vocabulary declared ONCE in scripts/procgen/seedlingWasmReadme.js, and ⛔ the row does not stop at the spelling: it asks whether the LABEL IS TRUE OF THAT TREE — `default` must be the build WASM_PAGE names, `demo` the entry declaring `demo: true`, `candidate` a strict capability SUPERSET of the default's and `control` a strict SUBSET (R9 slices P4E and DEF, 2026-09-27). (The `apitem-control` and `arm-control` roles retired with p4c and p4b on 2026-09-12, SEEDLING HEADLESS WEBGPU slice R2 — docs/history.md.) `source.commit` and `source.recompiler` are FULL 40-character SHAs because the table LINKS them: `builtFrom` abbreviated p4c's AS3 commit to seven characters and resolving it needed a clone of another repository. ⛔ THE PROSE FIELDS ARE NOT RENDERED — `builtFrom`, `namedBy` and `note` stay the long-form record and are read by people, not by the generator. The law itself now lives in docs/pin-policy.md; the retirements and the size policy in docs/history.md.

builds.note: ⚖ THE DEMO BUILD, AND THE REASON THE PIN LAW GREW A SECOND CLAUSE (⚖ user, 2026-09-07, ruling 4). Every other build here is pinned because a tracked file of Archipelago-CC NAMES it — an instrument drives it. Nothing drives this one and nothing should: it is the game a person plays, at https://peerinfinity.github.io/seedling-wasm/seedling_original/game.html .
